name: Syra Faizan
text: Amazing taste, great service! Loaded fries were unreal. Delivery was super quick too.

name: Daniyal Khan
text: The Mexican Wrap is genuinely one of the best I've had in Lahore.

name: M Mobine Ameen
text: Having a great experience — food was too good. Zinger burger is crispy and juicy.

name: Raza Mughal
text: Delicious food. Ordered Deal 3 for family night — everyone was full and happy.

name: Ayesha Malik
text: Best late night fast food spot in Karim Park. Malai Boti Pizza is a must try!

name: Hamza Shahid
text: Free delivery and open till 3AM — perfect after a long shift. Portions are generous.
